summary: Wiki sync and convention enforcement support for Goals page (Epic #218 / Feature #229)

entries.surface: bootstrap, health (report + MCP), wiki sync guidance (template), tests
entries.migration_impact: Bootstrap (apply or dry) now initializes docs/wiki/Goals.md placeholder when missing (after enabling wiki). gh plate health and plate_health MCP now report goals_page_present (nudge for convention adoption). Wiki sync template workflow comments updated to call out Goals as recommended. New projects get it by default via bootstrap; existing via re-run or manual. Complements #224 convention + #228 migration docs.
entries.agent_notes: Agents: plate_health now surfaces goals_page_present for discovery/enforcement nudges; Information Audit (#221) already reads Goals page. Bootstrap via gh plate bootstrap --apply (or MCP) will create the page file on default branch if absent. See updated convention in template_payload and Epic #218 children for full rollout.
